subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails` be hidden in full-verbose, cron, heartbeat, and mutating-action cases, or should those detail paths remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally preserve some detailed exec warnings, while the PR proposes hiding all exec-like warnings regardless of detail mode; code review cannot safely choose that user-facing policy.

options.title: Clarify Policy And Revise Patch
options.body: Decide the intended detail-mode behavior, then move suppression before or around mutating handling only where that policy says warnings should be hidden.

options.title: Keep Detail Warnings Visible
options.body: Preserve the existing full-verbose, cron, heartbeat, and mutating warning contract and narrow or close the linked request instead of merging this patch.

recommendation.title: Clarify Policy And Revise Patch
recommendation.body: Decide the intended detail-mode behavior, then move suppression before or around mutating handling only where that policy says warnings should be hidden.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared tool-error helper history and prior exec-warning merge make this the best available routing signal for the policy decision.
